'''''Tough 3''''' was a [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] serving the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The ship was part of [[Tough group]] which participated in the [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34]]. Tough 3, along with [[Tough 1]] and [[Tough 2|2]] following [[Ravtin group]], attempted to stop Imperial forces from capturing [[Onece 3]] of [[Onece group]] which carried their fellow rebels. Both shuttle groups were unsuccessful and were all destroyed in the process.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ship only appears in the Hard difficulty on Battle 1 mission 1.
